subtitle: 2026–27 season as of Fri Oct 23 — the rest of the regular season and every conference tournament simulated 10,000 times from the schedule, each team's rating shifted once per season by its uncertainty. Records are D1 regular-season games only (no non-D1 opponents). Title = first or tied for first in the conference's regular season; Outright = first alone. Tourney Seed = the mean conference tournament seed; Tourney = winning the conference tournament, and with it the automatic NCAA bid.
